syllabusCoverage.basis: SOF states Level 1 questions are drawn 60% from the current class and 40% from the previous class; Achievers questions are current-class only.
syllabusCoverage.interpretation: Apply the 60:40 split to the 30 non-Achievers questions: 18 current-class and 12 previous-class. Reserve all five Achievers questions for current-class syllabus.

reasoningTopics: Grouping of Figures and Figure Matrix
releaseGates: Every question has a unique ID, four distinct options, one verified answer and a meaningful explanation.
Every question is tagged with section, syllabusClass, syllabusOrigin, syllabusTopic and syllabusSource.
The current/previous-class origin quotas are met by each section and complete paper.
A 35-question paper totals 40 marks and runs for 60 minutes.
Question IDs and normalized stems are unique; answer positions and difficulty are balanced.
At least 50 full papers can be generated while avoiding question reuse in the preceding five papers whenever eligible pools permit.
Student, dashboard, Admin Question Bank and reporting integrations pass regression tests.
